text:
A type of
Modelled Process
that has
terminationBehav-
ior
configured to
processIsSelfTerminating
. This type of
Modelled Process
is allowed to self initiate termination proce-
dure (i.e. just terminate with exit status
EXIT_SUCCESS
), or wait
for
Execution Management
to initiate termination procedure
via
SIGTERM
.
